卖家发布服务。引导与中继帮助发现和连接，买方网关比较同模型、同结算币的报价与可用: Sellers announce services. Bootstrap and relay nodes help discovery and connections. Your gateway compares the same model and token, then selects an available seller.

问题发给卖家，卖家调用模型。: The seller receives your request and calls the model.
请求正文在买卖网关之间加密传输。卖家使用自己接入的模型服务生成回答，上游密钥保留: Gateways encrypt the request in transit. The seller connects to its model service and keeps upstream credentials on its own node.
回答逐段回来，买方检查是否收全。: The response streams back. Your gateway checks delivery.
完整、非空且报告用量未超预算，才进入付款确认。断流或检查失败，不签最终付款账单；: Payment requires a complete, nonempty response and reported usage within budget. Interrupted delivery or failed checks produce no final receipt. A complete answer can still be incorrect.
收到完整回答，再签实际费用。: Sign the actual cost after receiving the complete response.
买方按锁定价格和报告用量计算费用，在你授权的规则内签付款账单。这一步不上链，不为: Your gateway calculates cost from locked prices and reported usage, then signs within your permissions. This step stays off-chain, without a separate Gas payment for each call.
账单攒成一批，再上链收款。: Collect receipts, then submit a batch.
卖家保存签名账单，批量提交给合约。合约逐张核验、阻止重复收款，再从买家的托管预算: The seller saves signed receipts and submits a batch. The contract verifies each receipt, prevents duplicate claims and pays from escrow. Deposits, collections and withdrawals still need Gas.
网站展示卖家和报价；买方网关自己选路、签名。引导与中继帮助连接，不统一分派订单。: The website lists sellers and quotes. Your gateway chooses routes and signs. Bootstrap and relay nodes help connections; they do not assign orders.
卖家设底价，程序按忙闲报价。: Set a base price. Let capacity use adjust the quote.
容量占用上升时自动涨价，空闲时回到底价。每次调用先锁价，回答生成到一半不会临时加: Quotes rise as capacity fills and return to base price when idle. Each call locks its price before starting. Sellers can also choose fixed pricing.
先批预算，收到完整回答再批付款。: Authorize a budget first. Approve payment after delivery.
预算存进链上合约，单次意向和付款账单在链下签署。卖家攒多笔账单再收款，减少逐笔上: Funds sit in an on-chain contract. Per-call intents and receipts are signed off-chain. Sellers batch receipts to reduce the overhead of separate transactions.

服务和报价通过 P2P 网络传播。买方网关决定连接哪个卖家，没有中心调度服务器替: Services and quotes spread through the P2P network. Each buyer gateway chooses a seller without central dispatch. Bootstrap and relay nodes help establish connections.

你的 AI 可以调用服务、补充预算、收款和提议改价。你设可用模型、单次与每日额度: Your AI can call services, top up budgets, collect earnings and propose prices. You set models, per-call and daily limits, and permissions. Operations follow these rules and are logged.

目前模型来源和用量仍由卖家声明，真实 zkTLS 验证尚未接入。完整收到回答不证: Model origin and usage are still seller-declared; real zkTLS verification is pending. A complete response does not prove correctness. Sellers approve buyers during the pilot, and public-trading dispute mechanisms remain unfinished.
引导、中继、网站和上游模型仍有服务器组件。买方自主选路和授权付款，并没有把大模型: Bootstrap, relay, website and upstream model components still use servers. Buyer-controlled routing and payment authorization do not make model computation fully decentralized.
BEM 与 USDC 分别报价结算，不会自动兑换。测试币不代表真实资产，主网尚未: BEM and USDC are quoted and settled separately without automatic conversion. Test tokens are not real assets; mainnet is not enabled.
